source: Istio Bookinfo sample (istio-1.30.0/samples/bookinfo) on kind + Istio + Jaeger; see ../deploy/deploy.sh
capture_method: Traffic driven through the Istio ingress gateway (../workload/traffic.sh). Masked traces captured with ratings scaled to 0 (../workload/inject-ratings-outage.sh on); healthy control with ratings restored. Pulled from the Jaeger query API GET /jaeger/api/traces/<id>.

traces.note: 9 spans, all 2xx (ratings restored). Oracle silent — the control.

note: Small demonstrative corpus (2 masked + 1 healthy) for the hidden-downstream A/B. A >=100-trace nominal corpus (SP1 requirement) is produced by a sustained workload run; not required for the phenomenon demonstration.
